description:
You are helping a Sustainability Specialist prepare a board presentation. A presentation file is already open in LibreOffice Impress at /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/sustainability_report.odp with 3 existing slides.

Your task:
1. Insert a NEW slide after Slide 1 (so the new slide becomes Slide 2, pushing existing slides down).
2. Set the title of the new slide to: "Three Pillars of Sustainability"
3. Draw THREE ellipses (ovals) of roughly equal size (~8-10 cm), positioned to overlap in the center of the slide forming a classic three-circle Venn diagram:
   - One ellipse toward the top-center
   - One ellipse toward the bottom-left
   - One ellipse toward the bottom-right
4. Make each ellipse semi-transparent (set Area/Fill transparency to approximately 50%).
5. Color each ellipse differently:
   - Green fill for "Environmental"
   - Blue fill for "Social"
   - Orange or Gold fill for "Economic"
6. Add text labels for each circle: "Environmental", "Social", "Economic" (either as text inside the shape or as separate text boxes near each ellipse).
7. Add a text label "Sustainable Development" in or near the central overlap region.
8. Save the file with Ctrl+S (keep it as ODP format at the same path).

The final file should have 4 slides total, with Slide 2 containing the Venn diagram.
